decisions.rationale: Bring Archaludon, Pelipper, Swampert, and Tsareena. Leading Archaludon + Pelipper sets immediate Rain for instant 1-turn Electro Shot and high special bulk, while Wide Guard on Pelipper invalidates Mega Gardevoir's Hyper Voice. Swampert in back acts as our primary Swift Swim win condition under Rain, and Scarf Queenly Majesty Tsareena denies priority Fake Out pressure from Incineroar and Sneasler.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 Team Preview: Selected Archaludon, Pelipper, Swampert, Tsareena. Rain setup enables Mega Swampert Swift Swim sweep and 1-turn Electro Shot on Archaludon. Tsareena denies priority Fake Out from Sneasler/Incineroar. Pelipper Wide Guard shuts down Hyper Voice from Mega Gardevoir.

decisions.rationale: Anti-rain core: Dedenne 4x Thunderbolt OHKOs Pelipper to cut Drizzle; Venusaur-Mega Thick Fat tanks Swampert-Mega and 4x Giga Drains it; Farigiraf Trick Room reverses Swift Swim and Armor Tail blocks priority; Sneasler Close Combat breaks Archaludon/Garganacl. Lead Venusaur+Dedenne, back Sneasler+Farigiraf.
decisions.notebook: Anti-rain plan vs this opponent. Dedenne 4x Thunderbolt OHKOs Pelipper (cut Drizzle window). Venusaur-Mega (Thick Fat) tanks Swampert-Mega Wave Crash/Ice Punch and 4x Giga Drain KOs it. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Aqua Jet/Sucker Punch/Fake Out; its Trick Room reverses Swift Swim (opponent also has Mimikyu Trick Room to contest). Sneasler Unburden Close Combat breaks Archaludon/Garganacl. Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks my priority (avoid Fake Out while it's up). Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice/Shadow Ball covers Tsareena/Mimikyu if needed. Incineroar Intimidate pivot softens physical attackers. Watch Garganacl Salt Cure and Archaludon Electro Shot (rain-boosted).

decisions.rationale: Dedenne outspeeds both our leads, but Pelipper's Focus Sash guarantees it survives any single hit to set Tailwind. Pelipper using Tailwind allows Archaludon (105 Spe -> 210 Spe) to outspeed Venusaur immediately on turn 1. Archaludon's Electro Shot charges instantly in Rain, granting +1 SpA before attacking Venusaur. Setting Tailwind on turn 1 provides guaranteed speed control, plays around a potential Turn 1 Protect from Venusaur, and sets up Mega Swampert for a sweep.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 Turn 1: Lead Archaludon + Pelipper vs Venusaur + Dedenne. Rain active. Archaludon Electro Shot gives +1 SpA in rain. Tailwind ensures speed control. Mega Swampert in back has Swift Swim for fast cleanups.

decisions.rationale: Tsareena resists both Venusaur's Grass moves and Dedenne's Electric moves while blocking priority with Queenly Majesty. Sending Swampert directly into Mega Venusaur exposes it to a 4x super-effective Giga Drain. Preserving Swampert in reserve allows it to Mega Evolve and sweep with Swift Swim later in rain after Archaludon (+1 SpA) eliminates or heavily weakens Venusaur.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Mega Venusaur + Dedenne. Pelipper set Tailwind and rain before fainting. Archaludon is at +1 SpA under Tailwind. Preserving Mega Swampert for late-game Swift Swim clean-up under rain.

decisions.rationale: Dedenne (168) outspeeds Pelipper and Thunderbolt breaks its Focus Sash (guaranteed OHKO without sash). Venusaur Mega Evolves for Thick Fat bulk (survives Hurricane at 54-97%, no OHKO) and Giga Drain finishes the 1 HP Pelipper before/after it acts, removing the Tailwind/Hurricane threat. Archaludon's Electro Shot is only 0.5x on both my mons, so it's not an immediate threat.
decisions.notebook: Opponent rain team: Pelipper (Focus Sash, Drizzle, Hurricane/Tailwind/WideGuard) + Archaludon (Leftovers, Stamina, Electro Shot/FlashCannon/DracoMeteor/Protect) lead. Rain already up 5 turns from Pelipper Drizzle; KOing Pelipper does NOT remove rain, so Swampert-Mega Swift Swim still threatens. Unrevealed 2 likely among Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, Wave Crash/Ice Punch), Tsareena (Queenly Majesty blocks my priority), Garganacl (Salt Cure), Mimikyu (Trick Room). Plan: Mega Venusaur Thick Fat tanks Swampert; Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks priority + Trick Room reverses Swift Swim; Sneasler Unburden Close Combat breaks Archaludon/Garganacl; Dedenne 4x Thunderbolt handles Pelipper. Watch Archaludon Stamina stacking (Earth Power not reliable OHKO) and rain-boosted Electro Shot. Tsareena Queenly Majesty means avoid Fake Out while it's up.

decisions.rationale: Under Tailwind, both Tsareena (408 Speed) and Archaludon (210 Speed) outspeed Dedenne and Mega Venusaur. Tsareena's Power Whip into Dedenne heavily threatens an OHKO. Archaludon's +1 SpA Draco Meteor deals 61-129.7% to Mega Venusaur (currently at 71% HP), offering a high chance to remove Venusaur before it can attack with Earth Power or Sludge Bomb.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought Mega Venusaur and Dedenne. Archaludon at +1 SpA under Tailwind. Mega Swampert in back for rain clean-up.

decisions.rationale: Tsareena is the fastest, most dangerous threat under Tailwind. Venusaur Sludge Bomb (2x, 64-148%) can KO it, and Dedenne Nuzzle paralyzes it as insurance if it survives. Venusaur survives Tsareena's Triple Axel (~48-69% from 72% HP); Archaludon's resisted Electro Shot is the only added risk. Removing/paralyzing Tsareena blunts the speed advantage and lets us handle Archaludon next turn.

Archaludon's Electro Shot is resisted by both my actives; bigger threat is Tsareena's speed/damage.

decisions.rationale: Both actives fainted; must switch. Bring Sneasler (resists Tsareena's locked Power Whip, Focus Sash+Unburden doubles speed to outspeed next turn) and Farigiraf (Armor Tail blocks priority, Trick Room reverses Tailwind speed). Both survive incoming hits.

decisions.rationale: Under Tailwind, Tsareena (408) and Archaludon (210) both outspeed Sneasler (154-189) and Farigiraf (72-100). Farigiraf is the main threat due to Trick Room. Double-targeting Farigiraf with Tsareena's Power Whip (42-78%) and Archaludon's Electro Shot in Rain (31-58% at 0 SpA after +1 boost) has a high probability of KOing Farigiraf before Trick Room. Sneasler's Close Combat caps at 98.5% on Archaludon and triggers Stamina.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent brought Mega Venusaur, Dedenne, Sneasler, Farigiraf. In back: Incineroar, Gardevoir. Archaludon survives Sneasler CC from full HP and gains +1 Def via Stamina.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Sneasler)
decisions.rationale: Set Trick Room to reverse the Tailwind speed disadvantage (foes 303-408/210-274 vs my 189/72). Sneasler Close Combat is super-effective on Archaludon (64-132%, possible KO); even if it Protects, Trick Room still goes up and I control speed next turn. Tsareena is Choice-locked into resisted Power Whip, so Sneasler is safe this turn.

decisions.rationale: Protect with Archaludon while Tsareena uses Power Whip into Sneasler. In Tailwind, Tsareena (408 Speed) acts first. Against Sneasler at -1 Def, Power Whip deals 38–92% damage, leaving Sneasler alive without popping Focus Sash or activating Unburden. Next turn, Choice Scarf Tsareena (204 Speed) still naturally outspeeds non-Unburdened Sneasler (189 max) even after Tailwind expires, securing a 100% safe win.
decisions.notebook:
Game 1: Opponent brought Mega Venusaur, Dedenne, Sneasler, Farigiraf (In back: Incineroar, Gardevoir).
Our team speeds: Choice Scarf Tsareena 204 (outspeeds max Jolly Sneasler 189); Mega Swampert 244 in Rain.

decisions.notebook:
Game 1: Opponent brought Mega Venusaur, Dedenne, Sneasler, Farigiraf (Benched: Incineroar, Gardevoir). Our bring: Archaludon, Pelipper, Swampert, Tsareena.
- Scarf Tsareena (204 Spe) outspeeds Jolly max Sneasler (189 Spe).
- Sneasler: Focus Sash, Unburden, CC/Poison Jab/Rock Slide/Protect.
- Farigiraf: Mental Herb, Sassy, TR/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Helping Hand.
- Dedenne: Oran Berry, Cheek Pouch, Timid.
- Mega Venusaur: Modest.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler is at 26% HP and Tsareena's Choice-locked Power Whip (51-90% vs my -1 Def) will KO it this turn regardless. Best value is to take down Archaludon: Close Combat is super-effective and deals 42.6-88.5% vs its 25% HP, a guaranteed KO. Rock Slide can't break Archaludon (3-6.7%), and Poison Jab on Tsareena isn't a reliable OHKO. Farigiraf is fainted, so it passes.

reflections.summary: Leading Pelipper and Archaludon enabled instant Electro Shot SpA scaling under Rain, while Choice Scarf Tsareena cleanly swept Dedenne, Farigiraf, and Sneasler without needing to expose Mega Swampert to Mega Venusaur's Giga Drain.
reflections.adjustment: Be deliberate with Choice Scarf move locking on Tsareena—selecting Triple Axel or High Jump Kick when Sneasler is expected on field prevents unnecessary resisted hits into Focus Sash.
reflections.notebook:
Opponent Revealed Moves & Items:
- Mega Venusaur (Modest): Giga Drain, Sludge Bomb, Earth Power, Protect.
- Dedenne (Timid): Thunderbolt, Nuzzle, Volt Switch, Dazzling Gleam (Oran Berry, Cheek Pouch).
- Sneasler (Jolly): Close Combat, Poison Jab, Rock Slide, Protect (Focus Sash, Unburden).
- Farigiraf (Sassy): Trick Room, Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Helping Hand (Mental Herb, Armor Tail).
- Benched: Incineroar, Gardevoir.

Strategic Facts & Future Plan:
- Scarf Tsareena naturally outspeeds Jolly Sneasler before Unburden and shuts down priority with Queenly Majesty.
- Preserve Archaludon and Pelipper to eliminate Mega Venusaur early so Swampert can Mega Evolve safely under Rain in late-game.

reflections.summary: Lost because the lead tried to out-offense the rain core but lost the speed/momentum battle: Dedenne KOed Pelipper, but Archaludon survived with Stamina/Leftovers, chipped Venusaur with Electro Shot and then Draco Meteor KOed it, while Choice Scarf Tsareena deleted Dedenne and later Sneasler. Farigiraf came in too late and was KOed before setting Trick Room, so Sneasler's Close Combat was stopped by Protect and the team never got a clean window to break Archaludon.
reflections.adjustment: Change the lead/plan: start Farigiraf + Sneasler, have Farigiraf set Trick Room immediately (it survives one Tsareena Power Whip), and have Sneasler use Rock Slide/Close Combat to pressure Tsareena/Archaludon. Keep Mega Venusaur in the back only for a confirmed Swampert-Mega, not as an Archaludon check; if Dedenne is brought, treat it as a Pelipper sniper and protect it from Tsareena.
reflections.notebook: Opponent opens Pelipper Tailwind + Archaludon charge, with Focus Sash Pelipper. Archaludon has Leftovers/Stamina and Protect, survives boosted Close Combat after a Defense boost, and punishes with Draco Meteor; Mega Venusaur cannot take Electro Shot chip + Draco. Tsareena is Choice Scarf/locked to Power Whip, outspeeds Sneasler even after Tailwind ends, and Queenly Majesty blocks our priority. Sneasler's Focus Sash does not trigger on resisted Power Whip, so do not count on Unburden vs Tsareena. Farigiraf can survive one Tsareena Power Whip and must set Trick Room before attacking. Fourth slot still unrevealed among Swampert-Mega, Garganacl, or Mimikyu; keep Venusaur/answers flexible.
